answer: A newcomer joins a public horizon chain woven from willow links: each live job's output becomes the next job's input, so links must be done in sequence, never in parallel, and a stranger re-runs one link live and stakes 2 POA it was real. The newcomer posts an 8 POA shale bond per chain; a broken link slashes it and snaps the chain. The nth identity from one wallet must tend n chains at once and posts 8n-squared POA (1st 8, 10th 800, 3,080 across ten); one operator cannot run ten sequential chains in one epoch.
